text:
Alex Chen: Quick q — we're moving payroll from BrightPay to Pinnacle on 7/15. If I set 401(k) catch-up (50+) as Roth vs pre-tax in the portal, will Pinnacle treat the catch-up separately from my regular deferral or combine them?
Maria Gomez: Good flag, thanks. Do you have the employee ID so we can confirm mapping with Pinnacle?
Alex Chen: ID 3472. Also wondering about mid-month cutoff — last paycheck on BrightPay is 7/9 then next on Pinnacle 7/23. How are year-to-date catch-ups handled? :thinking_face:
Jamal Singh: Hi Alex — payroll here. Pinnacle stores catch-up as a separate contribution type but the employer mapping determines taxability. If you choose Roth catch-up in the Redwood benefits portal we surface that to Pinnacle as "Roth Catch-up" line item.
Jamal Singh: Practically: BrightPay will report YTD pre-tax/catch-up amounts on final file. Pinnacle picks up YTD via the transfer file but if anything mismatches we need to manually adjust the first Pinnacle payroll to maintain annual limits.
Maria Gomez: @Jamal any action items for ops team? We should avoid employees accidentally exceeding the IRS limit.
Jamal Singh: Action: payroll team will (1) review BrightPay export for 3472, (2) set a manual adjustment record in Pinnacle if Berkeley/Roth election differs, (3) DM employee if we need to change election before first Pinnacle payroll. I'll do that today.
Pinnacle Payroll Bot: Payroll import scheduled for 2024-07-16 02:00 UTC. Auto-verify YTD balances enabled.
Alex Chen: Thanks. One more — I'm going on unpaid parental leave Aug 1-31. Will catch-up be pro-rated or paused? I plan to return Sep 1.
Maria Gomez: Short answer: contributions pause on unpaid leave unless you elect to make after-tax catch-up via separate arrangement. Catch-up is subject to plan rules; Redwood's plan lets you resume and make catch-up later as long as you don't exceed annual limit. We'll confirm with Pinnacle for how they want the reallocation in payroll.
Jamal Singh: If you're not on payroll during Aug, no paycheck = no deferral. We can run a catch-up distribution strategy in final pay periods automatically if you want to front-load. Example configs we can set in Pinnacle:
```
# sample deferral lines for 2024 final pay period
REGULAR_DEFERRAL = 6% pre-tax
CATCHUP_DEFERRAL = 1500 USD one-time in Nov final pay
```
Alex Chen: That sample is helpful. If I choose Roth catch-up, will the one-time catch-up be taxed at Roth rates even though it's a makeup?
Jamal Singh: Yes — tax treatment follows the election on the contribution entry (Roth vs pre-tax). Makeup entries will be created as the elected type. We'll include a note in payroll detail for your records.
Maria Gomez: We'll also add a short FAQ update in benefits docs about mid-payroll cutover + unpaid leave + catch-up makeup so others don't hit surprises.
Alex Chen: Appreciated :thumbsup:
People Ops (bot): Action assigned: @Jamal to verify BrightPay export and set Pinnacle adjustment for 3472. Due 2024-07-16.
Alex Chen: ping if you need my signature or to re-submit election in the portal.
Jamal Singh: Will do — posting results back here once Pinnacle import completes. :eyes:
